fieldData.description: Join us for another Radix meet-up happening in Tel Aviv, Israel. This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Did we mention there's free food and drinks for everyone? And guess what... special guest Jeremy Epstein, the CMO of Radix DLT will be personally joining the event too!! Feel free to reach out to @ZomriZ on Telegram in case of any doubts or clarifications regarding the event.
fieldData.location: Landwer Café 13 Arania Osvaldo Street Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District Israel
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meet Up - Tel Aviv
